हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/XwQN3L
show.description: a young man named Ajay discovers he possesses mystical powers to both heal and kill with his hands, a secret he carries for fifteen years while building a business empire as the mysterious "Agyaat." After using his abilities to save the daughter of a billionaire and restore the beauty of his long-lost love, Nalini, Ajay faces off against the corrupt Mittal family who once tried to destroy him
